structured_output.rationale: Line 0 (97110) carries CO-236+N20 — a PTP bundling denial. The chart note documents a distinct service (separate start/stop, different body region), and the claim already carries GP+KX but no bypass modifier. Disposition hinges entirely on the CCMI for the 97110/97150 pair in the Q2 2026 NCCI edit file, which the 835 does not carry. The reference prohibits guessing this value.

awaiting_human.question: What is the Column Modifier Indicator (CCMI) for the 97110 (Column Two) / 97150 (Column One) pair in the NCCI PTP edit file effective for DOS 2026-05-31 (Q2 2026)?
awaiting_human.why_needed: CCMI=1 allows correct_and_resubmit via clerical-error reopening with an appropriate bypass modifier (anatomic or XE/XS/XP/XU/59) on the 97110 line, supported by the chart note's separate-site/separate-time documentation. CCMI=0 means the edit is absolute and the line must be written off (do_not_resubmit).
